# Package `crypto/sha256`

```go
package sha256
```

Package sha256 implements the SHA224 and SHA256 hash algorithms as defined in FIPS 180-4.

## Functions

### func New

```go
func New() hash.Hash
```

New returns a new [hash.Hash](../hash.md#type-hash) computing the SHA256 checksum. The Hash also implements [encoding.BinaryMarshaler](../encoding.md#type-binarymarshaler), [encoding.BinaryAppender](../encoding.md#type-binaryappender) and [encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler](../encoding.md#type-binaryunmarshaler) to marshal and unmarshal the internal state of the hash.

### func New224

```go
func New224() hash.Hash
```

New224 returns a new [hash.Hash](../hash.md#type-hash) computing the SHA224 checksum. The Hash also implements [encoding.BinaryMarshaler](../encoding.md#type-binarymarshaler), [encoding.BinaryAppender](../encoding.md#type-binaryappender) and [encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler](../encoding.md#type-binaryunmarshaler) to marshal and unmarshal the internal state of the hash.

### func Sum224

```go
func Sum224(data []byte) [Size224]byte
```

Sum224 returns the SHA224 checksum of the data.

### func Sum256

```go
func Sum256(data []byte) [Size]byte
```

Sum256 returns the SHA256 checksum of the data.
